note: Explode-beat layers. Positions share one world; see scripts/build-layers.mjs.

layers.title: Entire Table
layers.pitch: The assembled machine, as a player sees it.

layers.title: Exterior Cabinet
layers.pitch: Rail, skirt and pedestal in one welded body. The only surface a player ever touches.

layers.title: Center Column & Control Dome
layers.title_cn: 中心升降柱 / 玻璃控制盘
layers.pitch: Backlit glass dome, capacitive keys, powered dice bowl, and the lift column that raises it.

layers.title: Deck Cover
layers.title_cn: 轨道盖板 / 转盘装饰板
layers.pitch: One-piece PET deck with four recessed tile slots. The only interior surface tiles ever touch.

layers.title: Wall Builder & Lift
layers.pitch: Stores a sorted row, then a one-way geared crank lifts the finished wall flush to the deck.

layers.title: Shuffle & Feed
layers.title_cn: 洗牌桶 / 吸牌轮 / 输送
layers.pitch: Magnetic pickup wheels lift tiles face-correct out of the drum; a belt and cam head feed them on.

layers.title: Turntable
layers.pitch: Felted disc on twelve rollers. Tiles dropped through the deck land here and are swept to each drum.

layers.title: Structural Frame
layers.pitch: One folded steel deck carries every subassembly, so tolerances stack against a single datum.

layers.title: Power & Control
layers.title_cn: 电脑板 / 电箱 / 环变
layers.pitch: Toroidal transformer and the main board, in a shielded box slung under the deck.
